capabilities: render notes as cards with configurable image property, size, gap and title lines
group cards with headers, counts, and per-view collapsed state
select multiple cards to bulk-add tags, set properties, remove properties, or delete files
rename groups by rewriting the group-by property in every note in the group
toggle select mode via command or hotkey and pick properties to show per view
disambiguation: Not a general Bases enhancement suite; its main addition is the single Cards Plus view, plus a select mode for bulk actions.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0+ (Bases plugin API and declarative settings); the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: adds a Cards Plus view to Bases: a card layout like the built-in Cards view
problem: Obsidian's built-in Bases Cards view lacks image fallbacks, collapsible groups, group renaming, and multi-card selection for bulk edits.

relations.evidence: The community plugin Hot-Reload (pjeby/hot-reload) can also reload automatically

summary: A Bases view plugin that adds a Cards Plus card layout with image options, collapsible groups, and bulk select actions.
